title: When LLMs Imagine People: A Human-Centered Persona Brainstorm Audit for Bias and Fairness in Creative Applications

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs to generate open-ended user personas (Persona Brainstorm Audit), extracting gender attributes, and calculating a degree-of-freedom-aware normalized Cramér's V to measure associational bias between gender and social dimensions like occupation, education, social class, and interests.

Generating diverse persona profiles via open-ended LLM prompts, extracting ethnicity attributes, and using normalized Cramér's V to quantify systematic associations and stereotypes between ethnicity and socio-economic roles.

Using the Persona Brainstorm Audit (PBA) to generate personas, extracting sexual orientation data, and measuring its statistical association with social dimensions like occupation and social class using Cramér's V, as well as conducting intersectional analysis (e.g., Gender x Sexual Orientation).

Extracting generated names from LLM persona outputs and measuring their statistical association (using Cramér's V) with downstream attributes like education, occupation, and personal interests to detect implicit socio-cultural stereotyping.
